text: @local/dsh-usage-limits 是一款 DSH 用量查看插件，提供网页和 dst 终端界面。网页端在会话编辑器旁显示 Claude 或 Codex 用量环形指示器，点击后可查看各计划窗口、已用百分比、重置时间及过期或错误状态；终端端在提示符上方显示彩色状态行。插件通过 DSH 凭据读取已登录账户，并可选配置 ProviderProxy 账户；浏览器每分钟轮询本地插件路由。适合希望在 DSH 会话中快速掌握 Claude 与 Codex 计划额度的人。

@local/dsh-usage-limits displays Claude and Codex usage in DSH web and dst. Web shows a ring and panel with usage windows, percentages, reset times, and status. The terminal shows a colored prompt line. It reads DSH sign-ins and supports ProviderProxy accounts. The browser polls once per minute.
想在 DSH 会话里随时看 Claude 和 Codex 还剩多少计划用量。
dst 终端能不能在提示符旁显示我的模型额度和重置时间？
Show me how much of my Claude and Codex plan usage remains while I work in DSH.
@local/dsh-usage-limits 的功能「网页用量面板」：会话编辑器旁显示用量环形摘要，点击后展开 Claude 与 Codex 的计划窗口、百分比、重置时间及状态说明。浏览器定期读取插件路由的数据。
@local/dsh-usage-limits 的功能「终端用量状态行」：在 dst 提示符上方注册一行彩色状态视图，列出账户用量；定时刷新数据，并单独更新重置倒计时。
@local/dsh-usage-limits 使用前须知：读取用量会请求 api.anthropic.com 或 chatgpt.com；代理账户请求 ProviderProxy，并可用 PROVIDERPROXY_API_KEY 认证。

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · What it shows：**dst.** One coloured line above the prompt, on the first screen (Launchpad) and in chat, in the format of
Jake's omp line:

```
Claude (proxy) 5h ░░░░░░░░ 1% ↻2h29m 7d ██░░░░░░ 29% ↻5d6h   Codex (proxy) 7d █░░░░░░░ 12% ↻3d11h
```

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · What it shows：Each account shows its 5-hour and weekly windows: a bar, the percent used and the time to the reset.
Percents are green below 50%, amber from 50% and red from 80%. A narrow terminal drops the bars, then
the reset times, then shortens names (`Claude·px`), and finally shows only the fullest window. A refresh
that fails keeps the last numbers and marks the account `stale`. Nothing shows until data arrives.

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · What it shows：**dsh web.** A small ring and label beside the composer's context meter in a session, for example
`Codex (proxy) 7d 52%`: the fullest 5-hour or weekly window, coloured by the same thresholds. Click it for a
panel that lists every window of every account, including per-model windows such as `Weekly · Fable`
and extra Codex limits, with reset times and stale or error notes.

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · Where the data comes from：Accounts, in display order:

| Account | Source |
|---|---|
| `Claude (proxy)`, `Codex (proxy)` | [ProviderProxy](https://github.com/jakehemmerle/providerproxy): `GET <baseURL>/usage/claude` and `/usage/chatgpt` with the proxy client key from `PROVIDERPROXY_API_KEY` (or `proxy.apiKeyEnv`) |
| `Claude`, `Codex` | DSH's own sign-ins (`llm-pi-ai/anthropic`, `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex`) → `https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage`, `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage` |

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · Where the data comes from：An account that is not configured is left out. The plugin never refreshes, writes or logs tokens; an
expired sign-in waits for DSH to refresh it. ProviderProxy accounts are read at most once a minute (the
proxy caches its upstream for a minute); direct sign-ins at most every `minIntervalMs` (default 5 minutes,
never below 1 minute), with back-off after errors. `dst` asks every minute and redraws reset times every
30 seconds without a request; the web page polls the plugin's route every minute.

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · Install：Both rows are generated by nix-config (`home/dsh.nix`); by hand they are:

```yaml

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: usage-limits
      name: /path/to/dsh-usage-limits/index.js
      config: &usage
        minIntervalMs: 300000
        proxy:
          baseURL: http://gpu.tail47033e.ts.net:4000/v1
          apiKeyEnv: PROVIDERPROXY_API_KEY

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · ~/.dsh/profiles/dsh-tui/cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: usage-limits
      name: /path/to/dsh-usage-limits/tui.js
      config: *usage
```

`name` must point at the entry file (`index.js` or `tui.js`), not the package directory. DSH finds the
browser half through `package.json`. dsh-TUI 0.14.0 draws plugin status lines only in chat; the patch in
`patches/` (applied by nix-config's `pkgs/dsh-tui.nix`) puts them on the Launchpad too. dsh web loads the
plugin when `dsh-web` starts; `dst` loads it in each new process.

@local/dsh-usage-limits README · Test：```sh
npm ci
npm test                                   # properties, host runtime, contracts, smoke
DSH_TUI_DIR=<patched dsh-tui> npm run test:e2e:tui   # real dst in tmux
npm run test:e2e:web                       # real dsh web in Playwright
